title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Several Opinions on Further Strengthening the Building of the People's Court Team under the New Situation
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Several Opinions on Further Strengthening the Construction of the People's Court Personnel in the New Situation

Fa Fa [2013] No. 10

The High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Further Strengthening the Construction of the People's Court Personnel in the New Situation are hereby issued for your earnest implementation in light of actual circumstances.

October 8, 2013

Several Opinions on Further Strengthening the Construction of the People's Court Personnel in the New Situation

To thoroughly implement the spirit of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the important speeches of General Secretary Xi Jinping, in accordance with the deployment requirements of the National Organization Work Conference, the National Political and Legal Work Conference, and the Party Leadership Group of the Supreme People's Court, and in light of work realities, the following opinions are put forward on further strengthening the construction of the people's court personnel.

I. Importance and Urgency of Strengthening the Construction of People's Court Personnel in the New Situation

Strengthening personnel construction is an important guarantee for realizing impartial justice. For a long time, people's courts at all levels have always held high the banner, centered on the overall situation, served the overall situation, developed through inheritance, advanced through pioneering, and comprehensively strengthened the ideological and political construction, judicial capacity building, discipline and work style construction, and anti-corruption construction of the court personnel, providing strong organizational guarantees for promoting the scientific development of trial work, promoting impartial justice, and maintaining social harmony and stability.

China is in a critical period of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects. To thoroughly implement the spirit of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, comprehensively promote economic, political, cultural, social, and ecological civilization construction, accelerate the process of industrialization, informatization, urbanization, and agricultural modernization, and realize the "two centenary" goals and the Chinese Dream of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation, we must pay more attention to the important role of the rule of law in national governance and social management. General Secretary Xi Jinping's important discussions on the construction of the rule of law emphasize accelerating the construction of a safe China, a rule-of-law China, and an excellent personnel, striving to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case, and work must be improved closely around this goal. In the face of the new situation and requirements, the people's courts' responsibility to respond to the expectations of the people, ensure the implementation of the law, and maintain social fairness and justice is more arduous; the task of resolving conflicts and disputes and maintaining social harmony and stability is more heavy. It must be clearly seen that the current problems of the court personnel in terms of judicial concepts, judicial capacity, and judicial style do not conform or adapt to the requirements of the Party and the people are relatively prominent, mainly: the ability to guide the people to realize reasonable demands is not strong, the credibility of judicial judgments is not high, seriously affecting judicial authority; a small number of cadres and police have poor style, unfair judiciary, and even corruption, seriously damaging the image of the personnel; unreasonable allocation of trial resources, low judicial efficiency, brain drain in grassroots courts, difficulty in recruiting personnel in remote courts and other problems have long plagued personnel construction.

The current and future period is an important period of opportunity for the development of the people's courts. We must further enhance the awareness of the overall situation, responsibility, opportunity, and urgency, emancipate the mind, improve understanding, seek truth and be pragmatic, overcome difficulties, seriously study the prominent contradictions restricting personnel construction, continuously deepen the understanding of the laws of personnel construction, unremittingly explore effective ways to strengthen personnel construction under the new situation, strive to solve the practical problems existing in personnel construction, and open up a new situation of people's court personnel construction with greater determination and strength, laying a solid organizational foundation for comprehensively promoting the scientific development of the people's courts.

II. Guiding Ideology, Goals and Tasks, and Basic Requirements for the Construction of People's Court Personnel

1. Guiding Ideology: Hold high the great banner of socialism with Chinese characteristics, take Deng Xiaoping Theory, the important thought of "Three Represents," and the Scientific Outlook on Development as guidance, deeply study and implement the spirit of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, closely focus on the main line of justice for the people and impartial justice, aim at producing more good cadres needed by the Party and the people, adhere to the overall work idea of "grasping Party building, leading team building, and promoting trials," take the direction of promoting regularization, specialization, and professionalization, further deepen the reform of the cadre and personnel system, take the path of connotative development, comprehensively improve the scientific level of personnel construction, strive to build a high-quality court team that is politically firm, capable, excellent in style, fair and clean, and provide strong organizational guarantees and talent support for realizing the work goal of "striving to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case."

2. Goals and Tasks: Further deepen ideological and political construction, strengthen ideals and beliefs, unswervingly be builders and defenders of the socialist cause with Chinese characteristics; further strengthen leadership team building, adapt to the new situation of economic and social development, comprehensively promote the scientific development of the people's courts; further focus on judicial capacity building, adapt to the new requirements of judicial openness, continuously improve judicial credibility; further strengthen judicial style construction and integrity construction, adapt to the new expectations of justice for the people, always adhere to fair and clean justice; further attach importance to the Party's organizational construction, strengthen the advanced nature and purity construction of the Party in trial organs, effectively improve the team's creativity, cohesion, and combat effectiveness.

3. Basic Requirements:

-- Adhere to the principle of the Party managing cadres. Effectively strengthen the Party's leadership over the construction of people's court personnel, adhere to and improve the mechanism for the Party Leadership Group of the higher court to assist the local Party Committee in managing cadres, and give full play to the leadership and gatekeeping role of the court Party Leadership Group in the selection and appointment of cadres.

-- Adhere to serving law enforcement and case handling. Effectively enhance the awareness of justice for the people and impartial justice, continuously improve the ability to serve the overall situation and the masses, and strive to enhance the judicial credibility of the people's courts.

-- Adhere to the direction of "Three Modernizations" construction. Comprehensively strengthen regularization, specialization, and professionalization construction, promote the reform of the personnel classification management system, enhance judicial capacity, and improve professional security.

-- Adhere to the path of connotative development. Take improving capacity and quality as the foundation, optimizing the team structure as the requirement, and strengthening scientific management as the means, strive to improve the scientific level of personnel construction.

-- Adhere to reform, development, and innovation. Starting from trial practice, continuously deepen the reform of the cadre and personnel system, and strive to solve the deep-seated problems that affect judicial fairness and restrict judicial capacity.

III. Strengthen Ideological and Political Construction

4. Adhere to the correct political direction. Combine the actual trial work to deepen the study of the spirit of the 18th National Congress, continuously enhance confidence in the path, theory, and system of socialism with Chinese characteristics, and take firm ideals and political integrity as the primary criteria for building a cadre team. Strengthen education on ideals, beliefs, and political discipline, ensure that in major issues of right and wrong, the mind is clear, the stance is firm, and the flag is clear. Resolutely safeguard the authority of the Central Committee, resolutely resist statements that are contrary to the Party's line, principles, policies, and decisions. Strengthen the supervision and inspection of the implementation of political discipline.

5. Strengthen the concept of socialist rule of law. Deeply study the important discussions of General Secretary Xi Jinping, continuously deepen education on the concept of socialist rule of law, and guide the majority of cadres and police to continuously enhance their consciousness and firmness in unremittingly striving for the cause of the Party and the people. Improve the ability to coordinate the overall situation, be good at using political wisdom and legal means, and strive to achieve the unity of legal effect and social effect.

6. Practice the purpose of justice for the people. Seriously organize and carry out the Party's mass line education practice activities, resolutely oppose formalism, bureaucracy, hedonism, and extravagance, enhance the mass concept of Party members and cadres, focus on solving the prominent problems in trial and execution work that the people strongly reflect, and form practical results, institutional results, and theoretical results. Improve the regular centralized education mechanism.

IV. Strengthen Regularization, Specialization, and Professionalization Construction

7. Strengthen regularization construction based on classification management reform. Promote the reform of the personnel classification management system, actively explore the establishment of a personnel management mechanism that conforms to the characteristics of trial organs. Clarify the responsibility and authority relationships among judges, trial auxiliary personnel, and judicial administrative personnel, scientifically determine the ratio of positions and staffing. Strictly control the conditions for judge entry. Improve the judge selection mechanism. Promote the reform of the judge position sequence. Improve the clerk management system. Standardize the management of the judicial police position sequence, and eliminate unqualified personnel.

8. Strengthen specialization construction with the core of enhancing judicial capacity. Strengthen training on performance capabilities, broaden exchange channels, and strengthen multi-position and cross-department exercise. Focus on broadening knowledge areas such as human rights protection, public safety, social management, information technology, and public opinion response, effectively improving the ability to serve the masses, maintain fairness and justice, resolve conflicts and disputes, and guide social public opinion under the new situation. Establish a dynamic mechanism for training needs. Adhere to classified and tiered training. Strengthen training institutions and on-site teaching base construction, integrate training resources. Vigorously carry out online teaching and training. Improve the teaching teacher database, high-quality courseware database, and case database.

9. Strengthen professionalization construction with the focus on improving professional security. Promote the improvement of professional security policies and measures, enhance the professional honor of cadres and police. Explore the establishment of a judge status protection system to ensure that judges exercise judicial power fairly in accordance with the law. Strengthen personal safety protection, severely punish violent acts against the law in accordance with the law. Promote the establishment of a salary and welfare system that conforms to the professional characteristics of judges, gradually improve and raise salary and welfare standards. Strengthen occupational risk protection, improve the relief and assistance system for work-related deaths, accidental injuries, etc.

V. Strengthen Leadership Team Building

10. Select and strengthen the leadership team. Adhere to the standard of both moral integrity and professional competence, with moral integrity first, to select and strengthen the presidents of people's courts at all levels. Focus on leadership team building, strive to improve the knowledge, professional, experience, and age structure of the team, and enhance the overall function of the leadership team. Improve the procedures for recommending and examining leadership team members, and increase the intensity of active coordination and management.

11. Improve the ability and level of leading cadres. Improve and implement the learning system of the Party Leadership Group central group, continuously enhance the ability of leading cadres to grasp major issues, discuss major issues, and plan the overall situation. Strengthen the induction training and centralized rotation training for newly appointed presidents of people's courts at all levels. Strengthen strategic thinking, innovative thinking, dialectical thinking, and bottom-line thinking, and strive to enhance the ability to solve practical problems.

12. Implement democratic centralism. Improve the rules of procedure and decision-making procedures of the Party Leadership Group in accordance with the principle of democratic centralism, focus on solving problems such as insufficient democratic development, insufficient correct concentration, insufficient criticism, and insufficient strict discipline, and enhance the overall synergy of the leadership team. Strictly implement the system of intra-Party organizational life. Strengthen decision-making consultation work for important matters of the Party Leadership Group. Implement the system of reporting major decisions. Improve the mechanism for correcting errors in decision-making and the system of accountability.

VI. Strengthen Cadre Management Work

13. Focus on cultivating practical skills. Improve the cadre training mechanism, focus on enriching trial practical experience, encourage cadres to grow and exercise in positions with difficult conditions and complex situations. Increase the intensity of selecting judges from grassroots courts, improve the internal rotation and upper-lower exchange mechanisms. Improve the training system for reserve cadres. Strengthen the training of outstanding young cadres, pay attention to the training and selection of female cadres, ethnic minority cadres, and the allocation of non-Party cadres.

14. Improve the cadre selection mechanism. Select cadres according to the standards of firm faith, serving the people, diligent and pragmatic, daring to take responsibility, and clean and honest. Establish a systematic, complete, scientific, standardized, effective, practical, simple, and easy-to-use mechanism for selecting and employing personnel. Fully and accurately implement the principle of democratic openness, competition, and merit, improve the method of competitive selection, avoid "all promotions must compete" and "one exam determines the result"; improve democratic recommendation and democratic evaluation, adhere to public recognition and performance orientation, do not simply select by votes, further improve the quality of selection and employment.

15. Improve measures for cadre supervision and management. With the style of "leaving footprints in stone, grabbing iron and leaving marks," adhere to strict education, strict management, and strict supervision of cadres, resolutely oppose and overcome the tendency of being a "good guy." Seriously organize the reporting of personal matters, work reports, and integrity reports. Establish a "simple, practical, and effective" cadre assessment and evaluation mechanism, scientifically set assessment indicators, and focus on the application of assessment results. Strengthen daily management and supervision of cadres, timely remind or admonish cadres with signs or tendencies of problems.

16. Accelerate the construction of talent teams. Actively promote the work of "strengthening the court with talents," strengthen the training of high-level legal talents, and improve the mechanism for discovering and evaluating trial talents. Accelerate the construction of the "National Judicial Talent Pool," cultivate 3,000 trial business experts and expert-type judges by 2018. Broaden the sources of talent, increase the intensity of selecting judges from outstanding lawyers and experts and scholars. Implement the "Double Thousand Plan" for personnel exchange with higher education institutions.

17. Genuinely care for and love cadres. Adhere to a people-oriented approach, create favorable conditions for the growth and progress of cadres. Improve the incentive mechanism, strengthen and improve commendation and reward work. Deeply understand the situation of cadres, improve the system of heart-to-heart talks. Strengthen logistical support, improve the work and living environment of cadres. Pay attention to humanistic care and psychological counseling. Help solve the practical difficulties of cadres, especially young cadres. Seriously do a good job in the work of veteran cadres.

VII. Strengthen Party Building Work in Courts

18. Improve the pattern of Party building work. Adhere to the pattern of Party building work of "combining vertical and horizontal lines, linking up and down, jointly managing, and overall promoting." Establish and improve the responsibility system for Party building work of "the Party Leadership Group assumes overall responsibility, the political department strengthens guidance, the Party committee of the organ organizes implementation, and the Party branch specifically implements." Deepen the activity of striving for excellence, strive to make the Party building work of the people's courts take the lead in the Party building work of national organs.

19. Strengthen grassroots Party building work. Formulate guiding opinions on strengthening grassroots Party building work. Adhere to "establishing Party branches in tribunals," achieve full coverage of Party organizations and Party work. Establish a training system for branch secretaries, improve the ability of Party affairs cadres to perform their duties. Implement the "three meetings and one lesson" system, the regular analysis of Party members' Party spirit, and the democratic evaluation system, give play to the role of grassroots Party organizations in assisting and supervising the completion of various tasks of their departments.

20. Promote innovation in Party building work. Deeply carry out theoretical discussions on Party building, actively explore the laws of Party building work. Innovate methods and carriers, continuously enhance the attractiveness and effectiveness of Party building work. Establish a mechanism for Party members to contact and serve the masses, actively carry out activities such as Party member demonstration posts, responsibility areas, volunteer services, commitments and fulfillment. Improve the internal Party care and assistance mechanism.

VIII. Strengthen the Construction of Court Culture

21. Strengthen the function of culture. Formulate a development plan for court culture construction. Actively guide the majority of cadres and police to abide by professional ethics and judicial conscience. Vigorously promote the core values of socialism and the core values of political and legal cadres and police. Give play to the leading role of advanced models. Cultivate the noble moral sentiment and healthy life interests of cadres and police, always adhere to the correct value orientation.

22. Strengthen the construction of cultural positions. Strengthen and improve cultural construction and management. Do a good job in court news and publishing, build a platform for displaying judicial culture. Pay attention to the construction of online publicity and public opinion positions, run government websites, internal network of organs, and official microblogs well. Strengthen cultural theory research. Select cultural construction demonstration units. Establish a cultural construction evaluation and incentive mechanism.

23. Enrich the content of cultural activities. Implement characteristic projects of court culture construction, strive to highlight bright spots and brands. Deepen the construction of learning-oriented courts, widely carry out reading activities. Implement the judge oath system. Strengthen the construction of libraries (reading rooms), court history (honor) rooms and other cultural and sports venues, enrich the cultural life of cadres and police. Create high-quality works of court culture.

IX. Strengthen Grassroots Foundation Construction

24. Focus on policy adjustment. Establish a mechanism for staffing supplementation and dynamic management, ensure that 80% of the increased staffing is used for grassroots and trial frontline. Strengthen policy support for old revolutionary base areas, ethnic areas, border areas, and poverty-stricken areas, improve the pilot reform of targeted recruitment and training and the work of selected graduates, coordinate and improve the judicial examination policy, and focus on solving the shortage of personnel in grassroots courts in central and western regions. Implement and gradually raise the treatment of grassroots judges, stabilize the grassroots trial team.

25. Increase training efforts. Adhere to the regular rotation training of national grassroots judges, strengthen the job training for presidents of grassroots people's tribunals. Continue to organize regular lectures by instructor groups to conduct circuit teaching in western regions. Actively promote distance education and training. Accelerate the training of "bilingual" talents in ethnic minority areas, train 1,500 "bilingual" trial personnel by 2020. Further strengthen the national court intellectual assistance to Tibet and Xinjiang.

26. Strengthen the construction of people's tribunals. Further optimize and standardize the setting of people's tribunals, reasonably promote the restoration, new construction, and adjustment of people's tribunals. Strengthen information technology construction, improve work efficiency. Improve the level of support. Adapt to trial needs, allocate court staff.

27. Promote the work of people's assessors. Promote the establishment of a multi-department coordination mechanism. Implement the "doubling plan" for people's assessors, increase the number of people's assessors nationwide to about 200,000 by 2015. Expand the proportion of grassroots masses in the selection. Explore the establishment of an information database of reserve candidates for people's assessors. Improve the mechanism for people's assessors to participate in trials, implement "random selection," and promote judicial democracy. Strengthen the funding guarantee for the work of people's assessors.

X. Strengthen Style Construction and Integrity Construction

28. Strictly regulate judicial behavior. Strengthen discipline constraints and punishment. Regularly carry out supervision and inspection of compliance with professional ethics and behavioral norms. Broaden the channels for judicial openness, improve the transparency of trial and execution work. Further standardize discretionary power. Improve the system to prevent internal personnel from interfering with case handling, prohibit unauthorized approval, inquiry, and urging of cases. Establish and improve the mechanism for accountability and error correction for illegal case handling, promote strict performance of duties in accordance with the law.

29. Seriously improve judicial style. Persistently implement the spirit of the Central Committee's "Eight-Point Regulation" and the "Six Measures" of the Supreme People's Court, resolutely investigate and correct unhealthy tendencies that harm the interests of the masses and hurt the feelings of the masses, such as "cold, hard, horizontal, pushy," "eat, take, card, demand," "lazy, lazy, loose, extravagant." Organize various special rectification activities. Establish and improve a long-term mechanism to promote Party members and cadres to adhere to "serve the people, be pragmatic, and be clean."

30. Deeply promote anti-corruption. Formulate measures for implementing the responsibility system for Party conduct and integrity construction, improve the institutional system for preventing judicial corruption. Actively carry out various forms of clean judicial education. Promote the construction of a risk prevention and control mechanism for integrity, strengthen the supervision line of "early warning before the event, monitoring during the event, and investigation after the event." Give full play to the supervision role of judicial inspections, trial affairs inspections, and integrity supervisors, seriously implement the systems of avoidance of concurrent positions, prevention of interference in case handling, prevention of conflicts of interest, strictly implement the provisions of "four uniformities" and "five prohibitions," and resolutely investigate and punish violations of discipline and law.

XI. Strengthen Organizational Leadership

31. Focus on investigation, research, overall planning, and coordination. Create and form a strong atmosphere of advocating learning, being good at research, and applying what is learned. Conduct in-depth investigation and research, strengthen research on common key and difficult issues in personnel construction. Focus on top-level design and comprehensive supporting reforms, prevent unilateral advancement. Adhere to pilot projects first, actively and steadily promote reforms.

32. Strengthen institutional construction. Infuse the establishment of rules and regulations throughout the entire process of personnel construction. Respect the pioneering spirit of the grassroots, promptly elevate the innovative experiences from various places that are effective into institutional norms. Focus on institutional innovation, gradually form a scientific and complete institutional system.

33. Ensure the implementation of work. Implement the target responsibility system for personnel construction. Adhere to grasping at each level, pushing forward layer by layer, pay attention to giving play to the exemplary role of leading organs and leading cadres, higher people's courts set an example for lower people's courts, and the Supreme People's Court set an example for the national court system.

34. Organization and Implementation. This Opinion shall be specifically carried out and enforced by the political departments in coordination with the discipline inspection and supervision departments under the leadership of the Party Leadership Groups of courts at all levels.
